# Feature: Legacy Removal, Documentation & Release Gate

## 1. Feature Goal

**ID**: FEAT-029
**Source Plan**: `.spec-lite/plan_agentic.md`

Close the migration honestly: nothing in production code or documentation claims the old scaffold exists, only the thin provider seam remains, and automated assertions keep it that way. This feature sweeps every plan §10 deletion that earlier cutovers deferred, updates standing memory and generated/user documentation to describe the shipped design, and runs the full release gate (live-provider, no-LLM, browser, security, migration suites) against the plan §15 Definition of Done.

> Earlier features delete legacy code alongside their own cutovers (FEAT-026 deletes the manual loop; FEAT-028 sweeps ask/research plumbing). This feature is the **enforcement backstop**, not the primary deletion vehicle.

No runtime data model. The artifacts here are enforcement lists and gates:

- **Forbidden-file list** (test fixture, `packages/agent/tests/boundaries/forbidden.ts`) — paths that must not exist after cutover (from plan §10):

- **Release-gate checklist**: the plan §15 Definition of Done items, each mapped to a suite or an automated assertion.

### Indexes & Constraints

- Forbidden-file/import assertions run in CI on every commit from this feature onward (not just once at release).
- User-owned workflow YAML and run artifacts remain compatible (locked decision §14.7); internal `@yantra/agent` APIs take the clean break.
